about: This file is the picture beside it in numbers: the 3-D box (box_3d), the flight physics of the frame (flight_physics: every force as a vector in body / NED / camera axes with its magnitude, velocity, air data, coefficients, energy) and every element drawn (overlay: the box corners, the force and velocity arrows, the airflow streamlines and the panel values, in camera metres and pixels).

flight_physics.source: JSBSim flight-model state at this frame's sample (the frame record's 'state'); vectors rotated with the recorded attitude and the box's body_axes_in_camera

frames.body: x forward, y right, z down; metres about the CG
frames.ned: x north, y east, z down
frames.camera: x right, y down, z forward along the view

lift.name: lift
lift.source: state lift_n, perpendicular to the relative wind (wind-axes -z through alpha, beta)

drag.name: drag
drag.source: state drag_n, along the relative wind (wind-axes -x)

thrust.name: thrust
thrust.source: sum of state engineN_thrust_n along the body x axis

aero_axes_check.about: lift/drag/side force rotated through alpha and beta vs the model's own body-axis aerodynamic force

air.density_basis: 2 qbar / TAS^2 from the flight model's dynamic pressure
air.static_pressure_basis: ISA at the flight model's pressure altitude

coefficients.CDi_basis: CL^2 / (pi e AR) with e = 0.8 (stated estimate, not from the model)

lifting_line.basis: elliptic loading: L = rho V Gamma0 pi b / 4; the trailing vortices sit pi b / 4 apart; far-field downwash 2 CL / (pi AR)

box_3d.about: Per aircraft, in CAMERA coordinates (x right, y down, z forward along the view; metres). To rebuild the box from this record alone: corner_i = centre_m + sum over a in (forward, right, down) of s_a(i) * extents_m[a] / 2 * body_axes_in_camera[a], with s(i) = (+-1 for aft/nose, left/right, top/bottom; corner order for forward in (aft, nose), right in (left, right), down in (top, bottom)); pixel = K * corner / z with this frame's intrinsic_matrix. rebuild_check does exactly that and states the largest error against the recorded corners. orientation: yaw 0 = nose away from the camera, +90 = to the image's right, 180 = toward it; pitch + = nose up; roll + = right wing down.

aircraft.box_source: measured mesh box (shape_box) drawn; the stated-dimension box is the label of record

shape_box.basis: mesh_manifest version 4 mesh_extent_actor_m about mesh_origin_actor_cm (measured from vertices: nose keypoint (x), VRP (z: no gear geometry identifiable in the model (no gear_geometry patterns matched))), re-based on the CG (-x, y, z) * 2.54 of cg_structural_in

rebuild_check.used: centre_m, extents_m, body_axes_in_camera and the frame's intrinsic_matrix only
centre_m, extents_m, body_axes_in_camera and the frame's intrinsic_matrix only

aircraft.arrow_scale: length = 0.55 x 12.13 m x sqrt(F / weight), capped at 1.1 x 12.13 m; velocity arrow fixed 0.7 x 12.13 m along the relative wind

airflow.model: potential flow: free stream (relative wind) + Rankine body for the fuselage + lifting-line horseshoe vortex for the wing, circulation from this frame's lift. Analytic and fast; an illustration of the flow the forces imply, not a CFD solution

colour_ramp.range_basis: symmetric about 1.0, covering the 3rd-97th percentile of this frame's speed ratios
